body:
### Summary

When trying to build on SPARC, I'm getting:

```
error[E0432]: unresolved imports `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_DATA_INLINE`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_DELALLOC`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_ENCODED`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_LAST`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_NOT_ALIGNED`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_SHARED`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FIEMAP_EXTENT_UNKNOWN`, `linux_raw_sys::ioctl::FS_IOC_FIEMAP`
  --> crates/uv-fs/src/space.rs:13:5
   |
13 |     FIEMAP_EXTENT_DATA_INLINE, FIEMAP_EXTENT_DELALLOC, FIEMAP_EXTENT_ENCODED, FIEMAP_EXTENT_LAST,
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_LAST` in `ioctl`
   |     |                          |                       |
   |     |                          |                       no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_ENCODED` in `ioctl`
   |     |                          no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_DELALLOC` in `ioctl`
   |     no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_DATA_INLINE` in `ioctl`
14 |     FIEMAP_EXTENT_NOT_ALIGNED, FIEMAP_EXTENT_SHARED, FIEMAP_EXTENT_UNKNOWN, FS_IOC_FIEMAP,
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ no `FS_IOC_FIEMAP` in `ioctl`
   |     |                          |                     |
   |     |                          |                     no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_UNKNOWN` in `ioctl`
   |     |                          no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_SHARED` in `ioctl`
   |     no `FIEMAP_EXTENT_NOT_ALIGNED` in `ioctl`

error[E0425]: cannot find function `ioctl_ficlone` in module `rustix::fs`
   --> crates/uv-fs/src/link.rs:443:35
    |
443 |     if let Err(err) = rustix::fs::ioctl_ficlone(&dest, &src) {
    |                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ not found in `rustix::fs`
```

I've filed https://github.com/bytecodealliance/rustix/issues/1700 but I wouldn't hold my hopes high, since apparently it requires `linux-raw-sys` support and that package is a huge pile of hacks that I can't wrap my head around and doesn't support SPARC properly. Apparently their loong support is broken too and a [PR to fix it](https://github.com/sunfishcode/linux-raw-sys/pull/193) is being ignored for two months already.

So I think the best way would be to disable the relevant code in `uv` on SPARC.

### Platform

Gentoo Linux SPARC64

### Version

4bf8e7be2777dc545cd554ba91a4d9cd4bb9e594

### Python version

_No response_
title: Build failures on SPARC due ot missing symbols in `rustix::fs`
